physicalNotes: Radius 0.92 +/- 0.02 Jupiter radii and temperature 564 +/- 4 K from the retrieval on the JWST/NIRSpec spectrum by Baburaj et al. (2026, AJ 172, 28; arXiv:2606.19228), section 5.5: 65,772.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A model radius: the companion is unresolved. GM from their retrieved mass 25.2 +8.4/-6.0 Jupiter masses times Jupiter's GM; its mass has been debated from 1 to 30 Jupiter masses with the system's age (Bonnefoy et al. 2018). A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
